name: FLUX.1
tagline: High-detail open-weight text-to-image model rivaling Midjourney locally
real_test_summary: Rendered a 1024x1024 image with accurate embedded text in 9.5s on an RTX 3060 12GB using FLUX.1-schnell FP8 in ComfyUI.
pros: Accurate text rendering inside generated images
FLUX.1-schnell is Apache-2.0 licensed for commercial use
FP8 quantization runs smoothly on 8GB–12GB GPUs
cons: Slower per-step inference than SDXL on older cards
description: 12-billion-parameter rectified flow transformer image generator with Apache-2.0 Schnell and FP8 quantized checkpoints delivering crisp typography and photorealism offline.
